verdict.rationale: Egnyte's own pricing page lists a native capability to electronically sign PDF, Word, Google Docs and other documents, so signing happens where the files are stored. The only evidence is that one line in a feature list. missing for 10: in-depth first-party e-signature docs (signer workflow, external signers, audit trail, legal compliance), clarity on which tier includes it, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an operations lead, signatures happen where the files live — a native e-signature product or documented first-party signing integration

citations.quote: Ability to electronically sign PDF, Word, Google Docs, and other documents.
